abstract: A 36-year-old man presented to our hospital with right scrotal swelling. A computed tomographic scan revealed a mass in the right scrotum, multiple masses in the lung and liver, and enlarged cervical, mediastinal, and retroperitoneal lymph nodes. After right high orchiectomy, he was diagnosed with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (pT3N3M1b), with poor risk prediction according to the International Germ Cell Consensus classification. We started chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Since serum alphafetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) levels did not decrease to normal levels, second-line chemotherapy with paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin was administered. Six days after the start of treatment, the patient became unconscious, and his blood pressure decreased. Seven days later, blood tests revealed high uric acid levels, hyperphosphatemia, and increased creatinine. This was diagnosed as tumor lysis syndrome. Following diagnosis, continuous hemodiafiltration was started, and his condition gradually improved.
abstract_ja: 36歳男性が、右陰嚢の腫脹を主訴に当院を受診した。CT検査で右陰嚢内の腫瘤、肺および肝臓の多発腫瘤、ならびに頸部、縦隔、後腹膜のリンパ節腫大が認められた。右高位精巣摘除術ののち、国際胚細胞腫瘍コンセンサス分類に従い、予後不良群の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（pT3N3M1b）と診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を開始した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が正常値まで低下しなかったため、パクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによる二次化学療法を施行した。治療開始6日後に患者は意識を失い、血圧が低下した。7日後の血液検査で高尿酸血症、高リン血症、クレアチニン上昇が認められ、腫瘍崩壊症候群と診断された。診断後、持続的血液濾過透析を開始し、病態は徐々に改善した。
